answer: Proof-of-burn mechanisms mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to provably destroy native cryptocurrency tokens to register an identity. Instead of deploying a diffuse nebula of cheap clones, an adversary must forfeit scarce liquid capital per identity, facing an economic barrier as tough to crack as a walnut. While this eliminates zero-cost identity spam, it confines the market to an ivory tower that permanently excludes benevolent, underfunded micro-agents.
